import asyncio, httpx

def extract(s, h, url='https://example.com/sub/page'):
 s.extract_cookies(httpx.Response(200, request=httpx.Request('GET',url), headers=[('set-cookie', x) for x in h]))
def header(s,url): return httpx.Request('GET',url,cookies=s).headers.get('cookie')
s=httpx.CookieStore(max_cookies=3,max_cookies_per_domain=2)
extract(s,['a=1; Path=/; Expires=Wed, 09 Jun 2099 10:18:14 GMT, b=2; Path=/sub'])
assert header(s,'https://example.com/sub/x')=='b=2; a=1'
assert header(s,'https://sub.example.com/sub/x') is None
extract(s,['c=3; Domain=example.com; Secure; Path=/'])
assert header(s,'https://sub.example.com/')=='c=3'
assert header(s,'http://sub.example.com/') is None
assert s.get('a') is None
extract(s,['b=; Max-Age=0; Path=/sub'])
assert s.get('b') is None
extract(s,['bad=1; Domain', 'bad2=1; Max-Age=', '__Host-x=1; Secure; Path=/', '__Secure-x=1'])
assert s.get('bad') is None and s.get('bad2') is None and s.get('__Secure-x') is None
assert s.get('__Host-x') == '1'
s=httpx.CookieStore(); s.set('x','1',path='/sub'); s.set('x','2',path='/')
try: s['x']; raise AssertionError('missing conflict')
except httpx.CookieConflict: pass
assert header(s,'https://example.org/submarine')=='x=2'
seen=[]
def handler(request):
 seen.append(request.headers.get('cookie'))
 return httpx.Response(200,headers={'set-cookie':'foo=bar; Path=/'})
s=httpx.CookieStore()
with httpx.Client(cookies=s,transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)) as c:
 c.get('https://example.com/'); c.get('https://example.com/')
assert seen==[None,'foo=bar'] and s['foo']=='bar',seen
async def run():
 seen.clear(); s=httpx.CookieStore()
 async with httpx.AsyncClient(cookies=s,transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)) as c:
  await c.get('https://example.com/'); await c.get('https://example.com/')
 assert seen==[None,'foo=bar']
asyncio.run(run())
print('focused cookie checks passed')
